performance.subject: saved Program ledger boundary
performance.observation: the capacity lane admitted 4096 saved owners, refused the 4097th root before execution and kept the session usable; its lane wall time was 4042 ms in this export
performance.reasoning: no baseline for this path exists in this export, so the number is a bound and not a regression claim

tooling_observations.subject: live_slot_program_capacity.mjs report shape
tooling_observations.observation: the lane asserts the ledger boundary but prints a human sentence, so the boundary is not machine-readable; the corpus therefore records the declared 4096 constant and the exact 4096 + 2 invoke request sequence the constant produces
tooling_observations.reasoning: a structured report would let a corpus normalize the refusal stage and diagnostic without restating the declared constant; no runtime change is proposed

observations_for_issue_10.conclusion: No actionable Noble runtime regression or performance defect was observed. The bounded observations reproduced every frozen expectation; the only actionable item is the lane report shape above.
